task_description: Implement a modular auto-typing/input injection system with: immutable response buffers, typing queue with pause/resume/abort, pluggable injection backends (Win32 SendInput, Clipboard, PowerShell SendKeys, RobotJS), humanization engine, hold-to-type behavior, window target locking, and full integration with existing hotkey/storage/IPC/toast systems.

verification.summary: All files pass node --check syntax validation. Functional tests verify: backend name resolution (kebab-case + PascalCase), async injection loop completion, start guard without load, storage persistence. Review v1 found 7 issues (backend name mismatch, main-thread blocking, command injection, missing guard, no auto-load, dead code, clipboard race). All 7 fixed in follow-up commit. Review v2 approved with 2 minor non-blocking notes.
